notes: Village of Axtell audit, modified cash basis (treated as cash). Governmental lines from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p4-5). Governmental beginning_cash = beginning fund balance 1,394,737 and ending_cash = 1,403,687 (all assets are cash, CDs and county treasurer cash); ending_investments = certificates of deposit 650,325 (informational, included in ending cash). Transfers: the total column nets to (53,004) after the Reclassifications column; entered as transfers_out 53,004 (equal to enterprise transfers net +53,004 on p7). Business-type lines from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Fund Type (p7): operating revenues + interest and rental income as receipts; operating expenditures plus debt service principal (36,000) and interest (13,478) as disbursements (total 143,122 agrees with p1 total business-type activities expenditures); transfers net +53,004 in business_type. No printed single business-type receipts total; 232,129 = 223,168 + 8,480 + 481 (computed). Balance sheet = net position section of the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2), Total column; no liabilities shown. Detail: p8 All Funds budget schedule not recorded (duplicates the fund schedules p9-16). p9-12 General Fund Types schedule covers the General fund (ending balance 884,871), p13 Debt Service fund, p14 Special Revenue fund types (Road + Community Development Agency; ending 297,138), p15 Water, p16 Sewer. Detail lines with blank actual (cemetery capital outlay, sanitation misc, landfill fee, insurance proceeds, library repairs, pool/hall capital outlay etc.) skipped. Object 'Capital outlay' mapped to construction/infrastructure. Detail total for General revenue = sum of printed subtotals (not a single printed revenue total) and General expenditure total = sum of printed function totals excl. transfers; the printed total receipts 918,670 / disbursements 929,706 include transfers in 228,218 / out 355,873. Sewer p16 total receipts 74,590 equals total disbursements 74,590 incl. transfers out 14,381. AUDIT FIX: Debt Service schedule (p13) prints Transfers in (out) (21,252) inside Total receipts 81,687, so that other financing line carries printed_in revenue. Read pages 1-16 of 16.
